name: FROLIC
summary:
*About the Game *

If you are bored of monotonous 2D or 3D games, then it is time to move on and hop on the train of VR gaming. At Frolic, we offer the best VR experience with real-time interaction, which allows players to take actions flawlessly. 
Frolic VR features an artistic inclination to help users completely immerse in the game environment. Moreover, users can feel slight variations in the gaming environment like direction, movement, and vibrations making it more engaging and interesting.
